texts: The clinical question is persistence—not merely response
Before asking what the cell is, establish how long its clinical phenotype remains visible.

Durable remission is the exception that
the atlas tries to explain.

B-cell aplasia (BCA) duration
→ clinical persistence axis
→ BCA-L = longest-remission group
REPORTED BCA STRATA / MONTHS AFTER INFUSION
The duration axis is ordered, not a fitted continuous curve.
Clinical persistence is the entry point, not the mechanism.
Source: Bai et al., Nature 634, 702–711 (2024), Fig. 1c; background relapse context from the paper abstract.
